enable_daemon.description: Whether to enable the daemon mode to accept remote compilation requests

port.description: TCP port on which the distcc daemon listens for incoming connections

tempdir.description: Directory used to store temporary files during compilation

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections and concurrent compilation jobs

allow_hosts.description: List of hosts or networks allowed to connect to this distcc daemon (e.g., IP, CIDR, or hostname)

items.description: A single allowed host/network specification (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24' or 'buildserver.local')

log_file.description: Path to log file; use 'stdout' or 'stderr' to log to console

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after starting; leave empty to disable privilege dropping

compression.description: Compression level for network traffic (0=off, 1=fast, 9=best); empty or 0 disables compression

compile_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a compile job before terminating it; empty or 0 means no timeout
